rollbackMechanism: If first deployment is externally confirmed, rollback means stop/remove CRM service and restore previous routing/configuration state. If existing deployment is externally confirmed, rollback means redeploy exact previous image/configuration baseline.
rollbackValidation: Validate target health/readiness, traffic state, logs, and absence/presence of CRM endpoint according to deployment classification.
dataValidation: No production data changes are approved or expected.
